annotations.target_phrase: The building was modular, like some giant version of Cheap Hotel each coffin forty meters long.
annotations.annotation_text: Urban architectural decay in Baltimore: modular condo racks functioning as industrial human filing cabinets, reflecting the total commodification and spatial compression of human shelter.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 77.

annotations.target_phrase: W I N T E R M U T E printed in red felt pen
annotations.annotation_text: The first direct physical manifestation of the name 'Wintermute' delivered via Lupus Yonderboy and the Panther Moderns, signaling the artificial intelligence's covert orchestration of the heist.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 77.
